attributes.name: Smite Abomination
attributes.powers: On a combat check by a character at your location against a monster that has the Undead trait, discard this card to add 2d6. No other spells may be played by any characters on this check.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may attempt a Divine 12 check to recharge it instead.
